title: A rendering-based lightweight network for segmentation of high-resolution crack images (RLCSN)
mechanism: Transformer encoder plus a super-resolution boundary-guided branch and point-wise refined rendering for thin cracks.
adaptation: Crack-domain evidence for the PointRend arm and SR boundary branch; no separate run.
evidence: R: detects cracks as narrow as 0.15 mm from 3 m in UAV field tests; ablations per component.

alt_notes.adaptation: Crack-domain variant of the PointRend arm; same test.
alt_notes.min_experiment: Same as PointRend arm; kill crack IoU < +0.012 and relF1@2 < +0.01.
